name: workerbee
description: Workerbee — the system for talent decisions. Customer skills that orchestrate the Workerbee MCP server end to end: build a Success Profile, evaluate talent, rank a shortlist, manage invites, explain fit, compare people, find similar talent, log decisions, and improve the profile from feedback.

interface.longDescription: Workerbee is the system for talent decisions, in conversation. Build a Success Profile — the reusable standard for what good looks like in a role — then evaluate internal and external people against that one standard, rank a shortlist, explain why someone ranks where they do, compare people side by side, find more people like a top performer, manage invites, and surface the auditable decision record. Feedback improves the standard and re-ranks, so the system gets better with use.
defaultPrompt: Build a Success Profile for a role I'm hiring.
Rank the candidates for my open role.
Why does this candidate rank where they do?
